# Anastasis Giakoumatos

> Senior Mobile Engineer specializing in Android, based in Athens, Greece. 7 years building banking, payments and iGaming apps used by millions of people, and using agentic development (Claude Code, coding agents) and CI/CD automation to ship mobile apps faster without lowering quality.

Anastasis works daily with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on modern Android architectures (MVI, MVVM, Clean Architecture, multi-module). He has led large-scale modularization efforts, mentored developers, and raised code quality through testing and code reviews in large cross-functional teams. He also builds AI-powered features into his own apps and is available for freelance mobile app development through AGcoding.

## Experience

- Cognity (B2B contract), Senior Android Developer, Nov 2025 - present: Eurobank's mobile banking app in a 35-40 person Android team. Led a modularization moving 1,500+ files into 10+ new modules and introduced unit tests to previously untested modules.
- BetssonGroup, Senior Android Developer, Jan 2024 - Nov 2025: moved the Sportsbook from WebView screens to native Android with Jetpack Compose and MVI. Kept the QA rejection rate under 3%, held 96% crash-free sessions and reviewed 50+ pull requests per quarter, using AI-assisted and agentic development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini) daily.
- Viva.com, Android Engineer, Oct 2022 - Jan 2024: Viva.com Terminal app, used by 1M+ people in 10+ European countries. Added tablet and landscape support across 35+ screens, built Kiosk mode and led the app rebranding.
- M-Stat, Android Engineer, Oct 2019 - Oct 2022: built and maintained 15+ Android apps for insurance and loyalty clients, including the KRAFT Pro App (Impact BITE Awards 2021) and Piraeus Bank's Yellow app. Tech lead for one year.

## Projects

- [Cariboo](https://anastasis-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/cariboo/): personal car-management app on Google Play (fuel, expenses, service reminders, statistics). Built end to end through agentic development with Claude Code as a coding agent, Jetpack Compose and Clean Architecture; Supabase backend (auth, cloud sync, Edge Functions), GPT-powered voice entry and a GitHub Actions CI/CD release pipeline.
- [Honestli](https://anastasis-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/honestli/): freelance Android app that fights misinformation with tamper-proof Digital Originals, using C2PA metadata and blockchain anchoring.

## Skills

- UI: Jetpack Compose, XML layouts

- Async: Coroutines, Flow, RxJava
- Testing: JUnit, Mockito, Turbine

- Cloud and CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Supabase, Vercel, Firebase, Azure
- Certifications: Anthropic (Claude Code in Action, Model Context Protocol, AI Fluency), Agentic AI, Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose
